title: Grace Before Meals
text:
Bless us, O Lord,
and these thy gifts,
which we are about to receive
from thy bounty,
through Christ our Lord.
Amen.

translation.latin:
Benedic, Domine, nos et haec tua dona
quae de tua largitate sumus sumpturi,
per Christum Dominum nostrum.
Amen.

notes: A traditional prayer said before meals to thank God for His provision and to ask His blessing on the food and those who will eat it.
